程序包 org.bukkit

package org.bukkit
More generalized classes in the API. API 中更通用的类。

This package holds the core types of the Bukkit API. Bukkit is the static entry point of the plugin API, providing access to the Server, which in turn manages worlds, players, plugins and scheduling. Frequently used types include Location (position and rotation), Material (blocks and items), GameMode, Difficulty and WorldCreator.

此包存放 Bukkit API 的核心类型。Bukkit 是插件 API 的静态入口，通过它可获取 Server；Server 进而管理世界、玩家、插件与 任务调度。常用类型包括 Location （位置与朝向）、Material（方块与物品）、GameMode（游戏模式）、 Difficulty（难度）与 WorldCreator（世界创建器）。
